summary: Read suspension cause and snapshot mode before idle residency activation

replay.detail: Suspension projection reads optional cause and snapshot mode strings plus a keyed manual-conversion receipt. Missing metadata retains manual/Git semantics; unfamiliar strings remain intact. Authoritative claims are not rewritten.

schema.detail: No SQLite schema or checkpoint transition.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change or new claim kind.

compatibility.detail: Client-v0 suspension gains optional cause and mode strings. Older responses still decode; unknown values are preserved. Deploy these readers to every active member before enabling future idle/in-place writers. This change introduces no automatic idle producer. Older registries quarantine claims with new fields as authenticated raw records; they do not project those holds until upgraded readers retry admission. Missing metadata in known claims means manual/Git. Downgrade after activation is not promised.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond ordinary daemon replacement.

manual.detail: Explicit suspend converts an existing idle-suspended hold to manual without recapture or native-session changes. Keep future idle writers disabled until all-member reader support and mixed-version proof are established.

recovery.detail: Conversion receipts survive reopen and retain the existing suspension lineage. For future idle residency rollback, turn policy off and roll forward; do not rely on downgrading readers after activation.
